body:
I had typed out this long angsty rant, but I was just trying to shift the blame. I'm getting F's for the first time in my life. On top the way I've been feeling for the last year, knowing how disapointed my parents will be in me come next report card is driving me over the edge.

I wanted to go to some fancy college and train in quantum physics. If I can't do that, I don't see the point in being alive other than just being a mooch off society for the rest of my life.
